ios.desc:
Making it easy to capture and create 3D human animations
With this app, you can use just a single iPhone to easily capture a performance from the palm of your hand, thanks to Move's proprietary AI technology. Our software extracts natural human motion from video using advanced AI, computer vision, biomechanics, and physics.

Motion capture with a single iPhone
Using just a single iPhone, you can create high-quality human animation anywhere. This app provides an affordable and accessible solution by eliminating the need for markers, suits, or additional hardware. You can shoot creatively without the restrictions of traditional motion capture systems. The app is compatible with most iPhones, from the iPhone 8 onwards, up to the latest iPhone 15 model, running iOS 16 or above.

Capture anywhere
Move’s single-camera app isn’t constrained by suits or markers, enabling you to create 3D human animation in any environment, whether that's in a studio, on a football pitch, or even up a mountain. The setup takes just minutes, allowing you to capture single subjects in portrait or landscape mode.

Part of the Move platform
This app represents the single-camera version of Move AI's broader technology. The Move platform also supports multi-camera setups, enabling motion capture for greater numbers of actors and larger volumes. This flexibility makes it suitable for a wide range of professional projects, from indie creators to major studios needing scalable, multi-person capture solutions.

Export motion data into your 3D animation tool
Move’s high-quality motion data integrates seamlessly into 3D animation workflows, delivering professional results for game development, film production, marketing, virtual worlds, and more.

We’re committed to R&D
Research and innovation are at the core of Move AI. Our mission is to make human motion capture accessible to everyone, from solo creators to major studios. Using Move AI's motion capture products, anyone can access high-quality motion data that was once exclusive to large production budgets. We will continue to listen to our community’s feedback to ensure 3D animation technology is accessible and scalable for all.

quotes.text:
Hey, we have an iphone app [1] that turns video into 3d motion data. We're now launching an API that does the same. The API makes it suitable for integration into apps / platforms - we'd love to hear about your use cases so feel free to get in touch. Details and quickstart are at the url. More demos / details etc. on our web site. [2]

We're not quite ready for full self serve, but you can request an API key via this form. [3]

[1] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/move-one/id6448635527 
[2] https://www.move.ai/
[3] https://www.move.ai/api
